caption: Waag, Deventer
composition: Leaning weigh house on the Brink, stone stair platform in front · AI-generated artistic interpretation
description: The Deventer Waag stands at the south end of the Brink, a late-Gothic weigh house with corner turrets, an octagonal stair tower, and a stone platform of columns and side stairs. The building leans about eighty centimetres. The museum is closed. It is mainly clear, about 9.9°C, with wind near 8.3 km/h and cloud cover about 48%. The Lebuinuskerk is not in this frame.
